sql:
SELECT fish_date_doy, COUNT(*) as trip_count, 
  ROUND(AVG(yt::float / (anglers + 1))::numeric, 3) as avg_yt_per_angler,
  cls
FROM trips 
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC
LIMIT 40
